cover: UN: at least 2,230 civilians killed this year
2026 deadliest year for civilians, UN says
15,627 posts taken down in six months

stories.label: Sudan's war
stories.head: A UN count of the year's dead
bullets: More than 1,630 were killed by drone strikes.
Over two-thirds of verified deaths were in Kordofan.
No army or RSF response was reported.

stories.label: World · Life & safety
stories.head: 2026 is the deadliest year yet
bullets: More civilians died in ten months than in all of 2025.
UN monitors say missiles and drones cause most casualties.
Russia says Ukrainian strikes killed civilians in occupied areas.

stories.label: World · Assembly
stories.head: Arrests at the ASEAN summit
bullets: About 6,000 joined protests during Trump's visit, HRW says.
Detainees were held three days without charge.
Police said the street protests were not authorised.

stories.label: Who decides what you see online
stories.head: Six months of takedowns
bullets: Requests went through the Centre's Sahyog portal.
Police began legal action in 3,472 cases.
The government says the posts were fabricated or manipulated.
